so.text: 6. Waa intaasoo aad ku halaagto naftaada raadkooda (gadaashooda) murugo darteed, haddaysan rumeyn (Qur’aankan).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ زِينَةٗ لَّهَا لِنَبۡلُوَهُمۡ أَيُّهُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗا

en.text: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.

so.text: 7. Waxaan ka yeellay waxa dhulka korkiisa ah qurux lagu qurxiyey, si aanu u imtixaanno midkood ugu camal fiican.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَجَٰعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيۡهَا صَعِيدٗا جُرُزًا

en.text: And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.

so.text: 8. Waxaanuna xaqiiq ka yeeli dhammaan waxa korkeeda ah 'arlada' ban gabiib ah aan wax ka soo bixin.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ حَسِبۡتَ أَنَّ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡكَهۡفِ وَٱلرَّقِيمِ كَانُواْ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا عَجَبًا

en.text: Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder?[781]
en.footnotes: [781] Rather, it is only one of the many wonders of Allāh.

so.text: 9. Mise, ma waxaad mooddaa in 'dhacdadii' qolodii hogga iyo looxa 'ay ku qornaayeen magacayadoodu' [2] ay yihiin kuwa calaamooyinkayaga ugu yaabka badan [3]?
so.footnotes:
[2]. Ar-Raqiim: waa looxii ama indhalkii ay ku qornaayeen xikmadaha iyo wararkii asxaabul kahaf. Waana mid ka mid ah waxyaalaha cajabta badan ee Allaah abuuray. 
[3]. Bal waa mid keliya ee ka mid ah waxyaalaha cajaa’ibta badan ee Alle.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ أَوَى ٱلۡفِتۡيَةُ إِلَى ٱلۡكَهۡفِ فَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحۡمَةٗ وَهَيِّئۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَمۡرِنَا رَشَدٗا

en.text: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."

so.text: 10. Markay dhallinyardii u hoydeen hogga, waxay yidhaahdeen: Rabbigayow naga sii Xaggaaga Naxariis, noogana dhig arrinkayaga wax hagaagsan oo hanuun leh.

ayat.arabic: فَضَرَبۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ فِي ٱلۡكَهۡفِ سِنِينَ عَدَدٗا

en.text: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.

so.text: 11. Markaasaan ka dhowrnay inay (shanqar) maqlaan (oo ku sii deynay hurdo) hogga dhexdiisa tiro sanooyin ah.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثۡنَٰهُمۡ لِنَعۡلَمَ أَيُّ ٱلۡحِزۡبَيۡنِ أَحۡصَىٰ لِمَا لَبِثُوٓاْ أَمَدٗا

en.text: Then We awakened them that We might show which of the two factions was most precise in calculating what [extent] they had remained in time.

so.text: 12. Markaasaan ka soo kicinnay (hurdadii) si aan u muujinno labada kooxood midkooda tiro koobi og muddada ay ku negaadeen.

ayat.arabic: نَّحۡنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ نَبَأَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِنَّهُمۡ فِتۡيَةٌ ءَامَنُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ وَزِدۡنَٰهُمۡ هُدٗى

en.text: It is We who relate to you, [O Muḥammad], their story in truth. Indeed, they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.

so.text: 13. Annagaa kuu soo tebineyna qisadooda oo xaq ah, waxay ahaayeen dhallinyaro rumeysay Rabbigood oo aanu u kordhinnay hanuun.

ayat.arabic: وَرَبَطۡنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ إِذۡ قَامُواْ فَقَالُواْ رَبُّنَا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَن نَّدۡعُوَاْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَٰهٗاۖ لَّقَدۡ قُلۡنَآ إِذٗا شَطَطًا

en.text: And We bound [i.e., made firm] their hearts when they stood up and said, "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then, an excessive transgression.

so.text: 14. Waxaan ku xoojinnay quluubtooda [4] samir (iyo iimaan), markay kaceen [5] oo (ku) yidhaahdeen (boqorkii xukumayey ee sanam caabdudka ahaa): Rabbigayo waa (Allaah) Rabbiga samooyinka iyo arlada, weligayo ma baryeyno (caabudeyno) ilaah kale aan Isaga ahayn, (haddaan wax sidaa ka duwan nidhaahno) waxaan xaqiiq markaa ku hadallay wax xun oo xadgudub ah.
so.footnotes:
[4]. Waxay dhexdooda iskula ballameen inaysan caabudin axad aan ahayn Allaah, Macbuudka Xaqa ah. 
[5]. Inta abbaareen boqorkii Dikyanus ee daalim ahaa kibir badan.

ayat.arabic: هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمُنَا ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةٗۖ لَّوۡلَا يَأۡتُونَ عَلَيۡهِم بِسُلۡطَٰنِۭ بَيِّنٖۖ فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا

en.text: These, our people, have taken besides Him deities. Why do they not bring for [worship of] them a clear evidence? And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh a lie?"

so.text: 15. Kuwaanu qolodayada ah waxay yeesheen (Alle) sokadi ilaahyo ay caabudaan. Maxay u keeni waaayeen xujo cad oo u daliil ah? Yaa ka dulmi badan mid ka been sheega Allaah?

ayat.arabic: وَإِذِ ٱعۡتَزَلۡتُمُوهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُونَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ فَأۡوُۥٓاْ إِلَى ٱلۡكَهۡفِ يَنشُرۡ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُم مِّن رَّحۡمَتِهِۦ وَيُهَيِّئۡ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَمۡرِكُم مِّرۡفَقٗا

en.text: [The youths said to one another], "And when you have withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than Allāh, retreat to the cave. Your Lord will spread out for you of His mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility."

so.text: 16. Markaad ka fogaataan gaalada iyo waxay caabudaanba Alle maahee, ka doonta meel aad gabbaad ka dhigataan Hogga, Rabbigiin wuxuu wax idiinka fidin si waasic ah Naxariistiisa, oo idinka siin arrinkiinaan waxaad ku degtaan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَتَرَى ٱلشَّمۡسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَٰوَرُ عَن كَهۡفِهِمۡ ذَاتَ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَإِذَا غَرَبَت تَّقۡرِضُهُمۡ ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ وَهُمۡ فِي فَجۡوَةٖ مِّنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِۗ مَن يَهۡدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلۡمُهۡتَدِۖ وَمَن يُضۡلِلۡ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ وَلِيّٗا مُّرۡشِدٗا

en.text: And [had you been present], you would see the sun when it rose, inclining away from their cave on the right, and when it set, passing away from them on the left, while they were [lying] within an open space thereof. That was from the signs of Allāh. He whom Allāh guides is the [rightly] guided, but he whom He sends astray - never will you find for him a protecting guide.

so.text: 17. Waxaad arki lahayd qorraxda markay soo baxdo oo uga iilaneysa Hoggooda xagga midig, markay dhacdona ka goyneysa gadaal xagga bidix, iyagoo ku sugan meel ballaaran oo hogga bartanki ah. Arrinkani (waa mid) ka mid ah calaamooyinka Alle. Qofkuu Alle hanuuniyo uun baa hanuunsan, qofkuu lumiyana u helimeysid gargaare hanuunsha.

ayat.arabic: وَتَحۡسَبُهُمۡ أَيۡقَاظٗا وَهُمۡ رُقُودٞۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمۡ ذَاتَ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِۖ وَكَلۡبُهُم بَٰسِطٞ ذِرَاعَيۡهِ بِٱلۡوَصِيدِۚ لَوِ ٱطَّلَعۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ لَوَلَّيۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ فِرَارٗا وَلَمُلِئۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ رُعۡبٗا

en.text: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.

so.text: 18. Waxaad u malayn laheyd kuwa soo jeeda iyagoo jiifa [6], waxaana u geddinaynay kolna dhinaca midig, kolna dhinaca bidix, halka eygoodu (dhabbacnaa) isagoo ku fidinaya labadiisa addimood ee hore irridka laga soo galo; haddaad eegi lahayd xaggooda, waad iska soo geddiyi lahayd adigoo baxsad ah, waxaana kaa buuxsami lahaa baqdin.
so.footnotes: [6]. Alle wuxuu u soo diray hurdo asxaabul Kahaf ay la jiifeen 309 sannadood oo sannad bileedka ah. Eeg Aayadda 25 ee Suuradda Al-Kahaf. Xagga sannad qorraxeedka waa 300 oo sano, waxaa ku ziyaada sagaal sano xagga sannad bileedka.

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ بَعَثۡنَٰهُمۡ لِيَتَسَآءَلُواْ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ قَالَ قَآئِلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡۖ قَالُواْ لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا أَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡمٖۚ قَالُواْ رَبُّكُمۡ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثۡتُمۡ فَٱبۡعَثُوٓاْ أَحَدَكُم بِوَرِقِكُمۡ هَٰذِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ فَلۡيَنظُرۡ أَيُّهَآ أَزۡكَىٰ طَعَامٗا فَلۡيَأۡتِكُم بِرِزۡقٖ مِّنۡهُ وَلۡيَتَلَطَّفۡ وَلَا يُشۡعِرَنَّ بِكُمۡ أَحَدًا

en.text: And similarly,[782] We awakened them that they might question one another. Said a speaker from among them, "How long have you remained [here]?" They said, "We have remained a day or part of a day." They said, "Your Lord is most knowing of how long you remained. So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious. And let no one be aware of you.
en.footnotes: [782] By the will of Allāh.

so.text: 19. Sidaasaana u soo kicinnay si ay isu weydiiyaan dhexdooda. Midkood hadlay baa yidhi: Immisaad joogteen (halkan)? Waxay yidhaahdeen: Waxaan joognay maalin ama maalin galinkeed. (kuwo kale) waxay yidhaahdeen: Rabbigiin baa dhab u ogsoon intaad joogteen. Ee haatan ula dira midkiin lacagtani fiddada ah aad leedihiin xagga magaalada, hana fiiriyo cidda ugu cunno xalaalsan, hana idiinka keeno risiq, hana u dhaqmo si feejignaan leh iyo dhimrin, yeysanna cidina idin ogaan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ إِن يَظۡهَرُواْ عَلَيۡكُمۡ يَرۡجُمُوكُمۡ أَوۡ يُعِيدُوكُمۡ فِي مِلَّتِهِمۡ وَلَن تُفۡلِحُوٓاْ إِذًا أَبَدٗا

en.text: Indeed, if they come to know of you, they will stone you or return you to their religion. And never would you succeed, then - ever."

so.text: 20. Xaqiiq hadday idin ogaadaan way idin dhagaxyeynayaan, ama idinku qasbayaan inaad u soo laabataan diintooda, mana liibaaneysaan markaas weligiin .

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَعۡثَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ لِيَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهَآ إِذۡ يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ أَمۡرَهُمۡۖ فَقَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ عَلَيۡهِم بُنۡيَٰنٗاۖ رَّبُّهُمۡ أَعۡلَمُ بِهِمۡۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ غَلَبُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرِهِمۡ لَنَتَّخِذَنَّ عَلَيۡهِم مَّسۡجِدٗا

en.text: And similarly, We caused them to be found that they [who found them] would know that the promise of Allāh is truth and that of the Hour there is no doubt. [That was] when they[783] disputed among themselves about their affair and [then] said, "Construct over them a structure. Their Lord is most knowing about them." Said those who prevailed in the matter, "We will surely take [for ourselves] over them a masjid."[784]
en.footnotes:
[783] The people of the city.
[784] i.e., we will make this site a place of worship.

so.text: 21. Sidaasaan uga yeellay [7] 'dadka' inay ka war helaan arrinkooda, si ay u ogaadaan in Ballanka Alle xaq yahay iyo in Saacadda (Qiyaame) aan shaki ku jirin [8]. Markay dhexdooda kaga murmeen xaalkooda, waxay yidhaahdeen: Ka dul dhisa dhismo [9]; Rabbigood baa aad u ogsoon iyaga. Kuwii ku lib helay arrinkooda waxay yidhaahdeen: Waxaan ka dhiseynaa masjid halkoodii.
so.footnotes:
[7]. Doonista Alle. 
[8]. Waxay isku khilaafeen Maalinta Qiyaamaha inay dhaceyso iyo in kale? Ma waxaa la soo saari jirka iyo ruuxda oo isku dhan? Mise ruuxda keliya? Markaasuu Alle ka yeelay inay la kulmaan dhallinyaradan lagu xusay qisadan oo u caddeeyey in Qiyaamuhu iman oo la soo bixin doono jirka iyo ruuxda oo isku dhan. 
[9].Waxaan ka dhigi goobtan meel cibaado.

ayat.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ ثَلَٰثَةٞ رَّابِعُهُمۡ كَلۡبُهُمۡ وَيَقُولُونَ خَمۡسَةٞ سَادِسُهُمۡ كَلۡبُهُمۡ رَجۡمَۢا بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ وَيَقُولُونَ سَبۡعَةٞ وَثَامِنُهُمۡ كَلۡبُهُمۡۚ قُل رَّبِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ بِعِدَّتِهِم مَّا يَعۡلَمُهُمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلٞۗ فَلَا تُمَارِ فِيهِمۡ إِلَّا مِرَآءٗ ظَٰهِرٗا وَلَا تَسۡتَفۡتِ فِيهِم مِّنۡهُمۡ أَحَدٗا

en.text: They [i.e., people] will say there were three, the fourth of them being their dog; and they will say there were five, the sixth of them being their dog - guessing at the unseen; and they will say there were seven, and the eighth of them was their dog. Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord is most knowing of their number. None knows them except a few. So do not argue about them except with an obvious argument[785] and do not inquire about them among [the speculators] from anyone."
en.footnotes: [785] i.e., one from the Qur’ān, which is the only sure argument.

so.text: 22. (Qaar) waxay leeyihiin (waxay ahaayeen) seddex waxaana afareeyey eygoodii, (qaar kalena) waxay leeyihiin (waxay ahaayeen) shan waxaana lixeeyey eygoodii; iyagoo iska mala awaalaya wax ka qarsoonaa; (weliba qaar kale) waxay leeyihiin (waxay ahaayeen) toddoba oo waxaa siddeed ku ahaa eygoodii. Dheh: Rabbigay baa aad u ogsoon tiradooda, cidina ma oga iyaga in yar maahe [10]. Ee ha kala doodin (arrinkooda) inaad kula doodeysid xujo cad maahee. Waxnana ha ka weydiin arrinkooda midkoodna.
so.footnotes: [10]. Xagga Qur’aanka, ee ah xujada keliya ee la hubo inuu xaq yahay, wuxuuna Qur’aanka tilmaamay inay ahaayeen toddoba.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَاْيۡءٍ إِنِّي فَاعِلٞ ذَٰلِكَ غَدًا

en.text: And never say of anything, "Indeed, I will do that tomorrow,"

so.text: 23. Ha odhan waxaasaan fali berritoole.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ وَٱذۡكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلۡ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَهۡدِيَنِ رَبِّي لِأَقۡرَبَ مِنۡ هَٰذَا رَشَدٗا

en.text: Except [when adding], "If Allāh wills." And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct."

so.text: 24. (adigoo aan raacin) inshaa Allaah 'Hadduu Alle idmo' [11]. Xusuusona Rabbigaa markaad hilmaanto oo dheh: Waa intaasoo Rabbigay igu hanuuniyo mid uga dhow arrinkani toosnaanta.
so.footnotes: [11].Waxaa soo arooray inay qaar ka mid ah Yuhuudda ay su’aaleen Nabiga s.c.w. ruuxda iyo qisadii asxbaaul Kahaf iyo Dul Qarnayn. Markaasuu Nabigu s.c.w. ku yidhi: Ii kaalaya berrito anigaa idin sheegiye, mana odhan inshaa Allaah. Laakiinse waxyi kuma soo degin maalintii xigtay oo Nabigu s.c.w. uma uusan jawaabin? Kaddib waxaa soo degay Aayadaha 23- 24 ee la xidhiidha arrinkaas waxaana halkaa darsin lagu siiyey Nabiga s.c.w. wuxuu Alle kaga digay inuu ilaabo inuu yidhaahdo Inshaa Allaah markaas oo kale, waana u dersin sidoo kale ummaddiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَلَبِثُواْ فِي كَهۡفِهِمۡ ثَلَٰثَ مِاْئَةٖ سِنِينَ وَٱزۡدَادُواْ تِسۡعٗا

en.text: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.[786]
en.footnotes: [786] i.e., 309 lunar years.

so.text: 25. Waxay joogeen hoggoodii gudahiis saddex boqol oo sano, oo ay sagaal u dheer yihiin (sannad bileedka).

ayat.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُواْۖ لَهُۥ غَيۡبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ أَبۡصِرۡ بِهِۦ وَأَسۡمِعۡۚ مَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا يُشۡرِكُ فِي حُكۡمِهِۦٓ أَحَدٗا

en.text: Say, "Allāh is most knowing of how long they remained. He has [knowledge of] the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. How Seeing is He and how Hearing! They have not besides Him any protector, and He shares not His legislation with anyone."

so.text: 26. Dheh: Alle baa aad u ogsoon intay negaadeen, isagaa u (cilmi leh) waxaalaha aan muuqan ee jira samooyinka iyo arlada, arki ogaa oo maqli ogaa (wax walba). Ma ay laha gargaare aan Isaga aheyn, lamana wadaajiyo Xukunkiisa axadna.

ayat.arabic: وَٱتۡلُ مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ مِن كِتَابِ رَبِّكَۖ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَلَن تَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدٗا

en.text: And recite, [O Muḥammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord. There is no changer of His words, and never will you find in other than Him a refuge.

so.text: 27. Akhri (oo raac) waxa laguu waxyooday oo Kitaabka Rabbigaa ah, ma jiro wax beddeli karaa Kelmedihiisa, mana heleysid wax ka sokeeya Isaga aad magan gashid.

ayat.arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ نَفۡسَكَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلۡعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجۡهَهُۥۖ وَلَا تَعۡدُ عَيۡنَاكَ عَنۡهُمۡ تُرِيدُ زِينَةَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مَنۡ أَغۡفَلۡنَا قَلۡبَهُۥ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ وَكَانَ أَمۡرُهُۥ فُرُطٗا

en.text: And keep yourself patient [by being] with those who call upon their Lord in the morning and the evening, seeking His face [i.e., acceptance]. And let not your eyes pass beyond them, desiring adornments of the worldly life, and do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desire and whose affair is ever [in] neglect.[787]
en.footnotes: [787] Or "in excess," exceeding the limits of Allāh.

so.text: 28. Oo ku samirsii naftaada inaad ahaato la jirka kuwa barya (caabuda) Rabbigood subax iyo galabba iyagoo doonaya Wajigiisa, hana dhaafin xaggooda labadaada indhood adigoo doonaya qurxuda noloshan adduunka, hana adeecin mid aan qalbigiisa ka dhoohnay Xusiddayada oo raaca hawadiisa, arrinkiisuna yahay gabood fal.

ayat.arabic: وَقُلِ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمۡۖ فَمَن شَآءَ فَلۡيُؤۡمِن وَمَن شَآءَ فَلۡيَكۡفُرۡۚ إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ نَارًا أَحَاطَ بِهِمۡ سُرَادِقُهَاۚ وَإِن يَسۡتَغِيثُواْ يُغَاثُواْ بِمَآءٖ كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَشۡوِي ٱلۡوُجُوهَۚ بِئۡسَ ٱلشَّرَابُ وَسَآءَتۡ مُرۡتَفَقًا

en.text: And say, "The truth is from your Lord, so whoever wills - let him believe; and whoever wills - let him disbelieve." Indeed, We have prepared for the wrongdoers a fire whose walls will surround them. And if they call for relief, they will be relieved with water like murky oil, which scalds [their] faces. Wretched is the drink, and evil is the resting place.

so.text: 29. Dheh: Xaqu wuxuu ka ahaaday xagga Rabbigiin, ee qofkii doonaa ha rumeeyo, qofkii doonaana ha gaaloobo; Waxaan Annagu u diyaarinnay daalimiinta Naar ay gidaarradeedu koobi, hadday dalbadaan gargaar biyood waxaa loogu gargaari biyo daamur oo kale ah oo soli wajiyadooda. Xumaa cabbitaanka, oo u xumaa meel xusul la dhigo.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجۡرَ مَنۡ أَحۡسَنَ عَمَلًا

en.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of any who did well in deeds.

so.text: 30. Hubaal, kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo fala samaha, Annagu ma dayacno abaalgudka ciddii wanaajisa camalka.

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهِمُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ يُحَلَّوۡنَ فِيهَا مِنۡ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٖ وَيَلۡبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا خُضۡرٗا مِّن سُندُسٖ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٖ مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتۡ مُرۡتَفَقٗا

en.text: Those will have gardens of perpetual residence; beneath them rivers will flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining therein on adorned couches. Excellent is the reward, and good is the resting place.

so.text: 31. Waa kuwaa kuwa abaalgudkoodu yahay beero negaya (Jannooyinka Cadnin) oo ay hoostoodu qul-qulaan webiyo, waxaa lagu qurxin iyagaa Jannada gudaheeda jijimo dahab ah, oo labbisan qamiisyo cagaaran oo ka sameysan xariir jilicsan iyo xariir adagba iyagoo ku dangiigsan sariiro heer sare ah dushood. Wanaagsanaa abaalgdukaa, oo u fiicanaa meel lagu dego oo la xusul dhigo.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلٗا رَّجُلَيۡنِ جَعَلۡنَا لِأَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيۡنِ مِنۡ أَعۡنَٰبٖ وَحَفَفۡنَٰهُمَا بِنَخۡلٖ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمَا زَرۡعٗا

en.text: And present to them an example of two men: We granted to one of them two gardens of grapevines, and We bordered them with palm trees and placed between them [fields of] crops.

so.text: 32. Ugu soo qaadna tusaale labo nin oo aan midkood u yeellay labo beerood oo canab ah oo aan ku hareereynay labadaba geedo timireed, oo aan ka soo saarnay dhexdooda sarac kala duwan.

ayat.arabic: كِلۡتَا ٱلۡجَنَّتَيۡنِ ءَاتَتۡ أُكُلَهَا وَلَمۡ تَظۡلِم مِّنۡهُ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَفَجَّرۡنَا خِلَٰلَهُمَا نَهَرٗا

en.text: Each of the two gardens produced its fruit and did not fall short thereof in anything. And We caused to gush forth within them a river.

so.text: 33. Mid walbaa labada beeroodba ay soo saartay midhaheeda iyadoo aan waxba ka dhimin, kana burqinnay dhexdooda webi.

ayat.arabic: وَكَانَ لَهُۥ ثَمَرٞ فَقَالَ لِصَٰحِبِهِۦ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُۥٓ أَنَا۠ أَكۡثَرُ مِنكَ مَالٗا وَأَعَزُّ نَفَرٗا

en.text: And he had fruit, so he said to his companion while he was conversing with him, "I am greater than you in wealth and mightier in [numbers of] men."

so.text: 34. Midhona uu leeyahay markaasuu ku yidhi saaxiibki isagoo ay is la doodayaan: Anaa kaa maal badan oo kaa tol iyo tabar roon.

ayat.arabic: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُۥ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٞ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ قَالَ مَآ أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَبَدٗا

en.text: And he entered his garden while he was unjust to himself.[788] He said, "I do not think that this will perish - ever.
en.footnotes: [788] i.e., proud and ungrateful to Allāh.

so.text: 35. Wuxuu galay beertiisii isagoo dulmiyey naftiisa [12]. Wuxuu yidhi: u malayn mahayo inay (beer) tani baabba’ayso waligeed.
so.footnotes: [12].Isagoo isla weyn ka abaal dhacsan Alle. Wuxuu khayrka iyo barwaaqada uu heysto u nisbeeyey naftiisa halkii Alle, wuxuuna dafiray inay jirto Aakhiro.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةٗ وَلَئِن رُّدِدتُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي لَأَجِدَنَّ خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهَا مُنقَلَبٗا

en.text: And I do not think the Hour will occur. And even if I should be brought back to my Lord, I will surely find better than this as a return."

so.text: 36. Umana malaynayo inay Saacadda (Qiyaame) weligeed dhici, haddii la ii celiyona xagga Rabbigay waxaan ka heli meel tani ka rug doorsi iyo meel noqosho fiican.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ لَهُۥ صَاحِبُهُۥ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُۥٓ أَكَفَرۡتَ بِٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ مِن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰكَ رَجُلٗا

en.text: His companion said to him while he was conversing with him, "Have you disbelieved in He who created you from dust and then from a sperm-drop and then proportioned you [as] a man?

so.text: 37. Wuxuu saaxiibkiis ku yidhi isagoo la doodaya; Ma waxaad ku gaalowday Kan Isagu kaa abuuray carro, haddana dhibic mani ah, haddana kaa dhigay nin dhan.

ayat.arabic: لَّٰكِنَّا۠ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِرَبِّيٓ أَحَدٗا

en.text: But as for me, He is Allāh, my Lord, and I do not associate with my Lord anyone.

so.text: 38. Waa se Allaah, Rabbigay, lana wadaajin maayo cidna Rabbigay cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡلَآ إِذۡ دَخَلۡتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلۡتَ مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِۚ إِن تَرَنِ أَنَا۠ أَقَلَّ مِنكَ مَالٗا وَوَلَدٗا

en.text: And why did you, when you entered your garden, not say, 'What Allāh willed [has occurred]; there is no power except in Allāh'? Although you see me less than you in wealth and children,

so.text: 39. Maxaadan markaad gashay beertaada u odhan: Maashaa Allaah (waxa uu Alle doono ayaa ahaan)! Ma jiro xoog 'iyo xeelad' xagga Alle mooyee? Haddaad aragtay inaan kaa maal iyo carruur yarahay.

ayat.arabic: فَعَسَىٰ رَبِّيٓ أَن يُؤۡتِيَنِ خَيۡرٗا مِّن جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهَا حُسۡبَانٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتُصۡبِحَ صَعِيدٗا زَلَقًا

en.text: It may be that my Lord will give me [something] better than your garden and will send upon it a [disastrous] penalty from the sky, and it will become a smooth, dusty ground,

so.text: 40. Waa intaasoo uu Rabbigay i siiyo wax ka khayr badan beertaada, kuna soo diro biriq cir ka soo dhac ah, markaas noqoto dhul gabiib ah oo aan dhir lahayn.

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ يُصۡبِحَ مَآؤُهَا غَوۡرٗا فَلَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ لَهُۥ طَلَبٗا

en.text: Or its water will become sunken [into the earth], so you would never be able to seek it."

so.text: 41. Ama ahaadaan biyaheedu kuwa gudha, oo aad kari doonin inaad gaarto.

ayat.arabic: وَأُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِۦ فَأَصۡبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيۡهِ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَنفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أُشۡرِكۡ بِرَبِّيٓ أَحَدٗا

en.text: And his fruits were encompassed [by ruin], so he began to turn his hands about [in dismay] over what he had spent on it, while it had collapsed upon its trellises, and said, "Oh, I wish I had not associated with my Lord anyone."[789]
en.footnotes: [789] He attributed his prosperity to himself rather than to Allāh and disbelieved in the account of the Hereafter.

so.text: 42. Waa la koobay midhahiisii (oo la baabba’iyey), markaasuu wuxuu billaabay inuu 'kor iyo hoos u' geddiyo calaacalahiisa wuxuu maal ku baxshay darteed, iyadoo cid la’ ah oo isku soo hoos dhaceen saqafyadeedii, wuxuuna yidhi: Alla anigaa! Ii rooneydaa inaan la wadaajin Rabbigay cibaadada cidna.

ayat.arabic: وَلَمۡ تَكُن لَّهُۥ فِئَةٞ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنتَصِرًا

en.text: And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor could he defend himself.

so.text: 43. Uma ahaanin koox u gargaarta oo Alle sokadi ah, mana aha mid is difaaci kara.

ayat.arabic: هُنَالِكَ ٱلۡوَلَٰيَةُ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ هُوَ خَيۡرٞ ثَوَابٗا وَخَيۡرٌ عُقۡبٗا

en.text: There[790] the authority is [completely] for Allāh, the Truth. He is best in reward and best in outcome.
en.footnotes: [790] i.e., at such a time or on the Day of Judgement.

so.text: 44. Halkaasi [13], awood oo dhan waxaa leh Allaah, Xaqa ah. Isagaa u abaal marin wanaagsan oo u cidhib san.
so.footnotes: [13]. Waqtigaas ama Maalinta Qiyaamaha

ayat.arabic: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخۡتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَأَصۡبَحَ هَشِيمٗا تَذۡرُوهُ ٱلرِّيَٰحُۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مُّقۡتَدِرًا

en.text: And present to them the example of the life of this world, [its being] like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it[791] and [then] it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And Allāh is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability.
en.footnotes: [791] Absorbs it, growing lush and thick.

so.text:
45. Ugu soo qaad tusaale nolosha  
adduunkan inay la mid tahay biyaha aan ka soo dejinno daruuraha, markaa dhirta ka soo baxda dhulka noqoto mid isku darsanta, haddana noqota xaabo engeg ah u burburta gaballo ay dabeyshu firdhiso.  Alle wuxuu ku leeyahay awood wax walba dushood.

ayat.arabic: ٱلۡمَالُ وَٱلۡبَنُونَ زِينَةُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَٱلۡبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابٗا وَخَيۡرٌ أَمَلٗا

en.text: Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord[792] for reward and better for [one's] hope.
en.footnotes: [792] i.e., in His sight or evaluation.

so.text: 46. Maalka iyo carruurtu waa quruxda nolosha adduunkan, ha yeeshee (Alle Xuska iyo) camallada wanaagsan ee baaqiga ah baa xagga Rabbigaa khayr roon oo rajo wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ نُسَيِّرُ ٱلۡجِبَالَ وَتَرَى ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَارِزَةٗ وَحَشَرۡنَٰهُمۡ فَلَمۡ نُغَادِرۡ مِنۡهُمۡ أَحَدٗا

en.text: And [warn of] the Day when We will remove the mountains and you will see the earth exposed,[793] and We will gather them and not leave behind from them anyone.
en.footnotes: [793] i.e., flattened and bare.

so.text: 47. Oo (ka dig) maalinta aan ka yeeli buuraha inay tagaan, waxaadna arki dhulka oo ban muuqda ahoo siman, waxaanu soo kulmin iyaga Annagoo aan uga soo tagin gadaal midkoodna.

ayat.arabic: وَعُرِضُواْ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ صَفّٗا لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتُمُونَا كَمَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةِۭۚ بَلۡ زَعَمۡتُمۡ أَلَّن نَّجۡعَلَ لَكُم مَّوۡعِدٗا

en.text: And they will be presented before your Lord in rows, [and He will say], "You have certainly come to Us just as We created you the first time. But you claimed that We would never make for you an appointment."

so.text: 48. Waxaa la keeni Rabbigaa horti iyagoo u taagan saf saf: Waxaad dhab ahaan noogu timaaddeen idinkoo ah sidii aan idiin abuurnay kal hore (cago cad oo qaawan). Mayee waxaad mooddeen inaynu idiin yeelin waqti aan ku oofiinno ballanka.

ayat.arabic: وَوُضِعَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ فَتَرَى ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ مُشۡفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِيهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَٰوَيۡلَتَنَا مَالِ هَٰذَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةٗ وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّآ أَحۡصَىٰهَاۚ وَوَجَدُواْ مَا عَمِلُواْ حَاضِرٗاۗ وَلَا يَظۡلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدٗا

en.text: And the record [of deeds] will be placed [open], and you will see the criminals fearful of that within it, and they will say, "Oh, woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing small or great except that it has enumerated it?" And they will find what they did present [before them]. And your Lord does injustice to no one.

so.text: 49. Waxaa la soo hor dhigi Kitaabka (camalladooda ku qoran yihiin), markaasaad arkeysaa denbiilayaasha oo ka baqaya waxa ku yaal. Waxayna odhan: Alla hooggayaga'e! Muxuu yahay Kitaabkani aan dhaafeyn wax yar iyo wax weynba inuu tiro koobo ma’ahee, waxayna heli waxay camal faleen oo hortooda yaal. Ma dulmiyo Rabbigaa axadna.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِۦٓۗ أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُۥ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِي وَهُمۡ لَكُمۡ عَدُوُّۢۚ بِئۡسَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَدَلٗا

en.text: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was of the jinn and departed from [i.e., disobeyed] the command of his Lord. Then will you take him and his descendants as allies other than Me while they are enemies to you? Wretched it is for the wrongdoers as an exchange.

so.text: 50. (Xus) markaan ku nidhi malaa’igta: U sujuuda Aadam, oo ay u sujuudeen Ibliis maahee (ma u yeelin). Wuxuu ka mid ahaa jinka; wuxuu caasiyey Amarka Rabbigi. Ee ma waxaad ka yeelaneysaan isaga iyo durrayaddiisa gargaarayaal Aniga ka sokow iyagoo cadow idiin ah? Xumaa waxay wax ku doorsadeen daalimiintu.

ayat.arabic: ۞ مَّآ أَشۡهَدتُّهُمۡ خَلۡقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا خَلۡقَ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمَا كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ ٱلۡمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدٗا

en.text: I did not make them witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth or to the creation of themselves, and I would not have taken the misguiders as assistants.

so.text: 51. Ugama dhigan marag kuwaas abuurista samooyinka iyo arlada iyo abuurista nafahooda midna, mana Ahi mid ka yeelan kuwa wax dhumiya cudud.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يَقُولُ نَادُواْ شُرَكَآءِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمۡتُمۡ فَدَعَوۡهُمۡ فَلَمۡ يَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لَهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّوۡبِقٗا

en.text: And [warn of] the Day when He will say, "Call My 'partners' whom you claimed," and they will invoke them, but they will not respond to them. And We will put between them [a valley of] destruction.

so.text: 52. (Ka dig) Maalinta uu Alle odhan: U yeedha kuwa aad u heysateen inay yihiin shurukadeyda (oo aad ila barbar caabuddeen). Markaasay u yeedhi, uma ay se jawaabayaan, waxaanuna yeeli dhexdooda xannib.

ayat.arabic: وَرَءَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ ٱلنَّارَ فَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ عَنۡهَا مَصۡرِفٗا

en.text: And the criminals will see the Fire and will be certain that they are to fall therein. And they will not find from it a way elsewhere.

so.text: 53. Waxay arki denbiilayaashu Naarta, oo yaqiinsan inay ku dhici, mana helayaan meelay kaga weecdaan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَا فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ لِلنَّاسِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖۚ وَكَانَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَكۡثَرَ شَيۡءٖ جَدَلٗا

en.text: And We have certainly diversified in this Qur’ān for the people from every [kind of] example; but man has ever been, most of anything, [prone to] dispute.

so.text: 54. Waxaan dhab ahaan dadka ugu caddaynay Qur’aankan nooc kasta oo tusaale ah. Aadmigu waa kan wax walba ugu dood badan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤۡمِنُوٓاْ إِذۡ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُمۡ سُنَّةُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ قُبُلٗا

en.text: And nothing has prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that there [must] befall them the [accustomed] precedent of the former peoples[794] or that the punishment should come [directly] before them.
en.footnotes: [794] Who denied the truth brought by Allāh's messengers.

so.text: 55. Ma jiro wax ka cesha dadka inay rumeeyaan markuu Hanuunku u yimid iyo inay weydiistaan denbi dhaaf Rabbigood, aan ahayn 'dalabkooda' inay u timaaddo wixii ku dhacay kuwii hore [14], ama uu ugu yimaado cadaabka si fool ka fool ah.
so.footnotes: [14]. Ee beeniyey Xaqii ay u keeneen Anbiyada Alle.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا نُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَۚ وَيُجَٰدِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُواْ بِهِ ٱلۡحَقَّۖ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِي وَمَآ أُنذِرُواْ هُزُوٗا

en.text: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. And those who disbelieve dispute by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth and have taken My verses, and that of which they are warned, in ridicule.

so.text: 56. Uma soo dirno Rususha waxaan ahayn inay ahaadaan bishaareeyayaal iyo digayaal, waxayna kuwa gaalooba ku doodaan baadil si ay ugu buriyaan Xaqa Oo ka dhigtaan Aayadahayga iyo waxa looga digo dheel dheel.

ayat.arabic: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ فَأَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهَا وَنَسِيَ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُۚ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفۡقَهُوهُ وَفِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٗاۖ وَإِن تَدۡعُهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهۡتَدُوٓاْ إِذًا أَبَدٗا

en.text: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever.

so.text: 57. Yaa ka dulmi badan mid lagu waaniyo Aayadaha Rabbigi, markaas ka sii jeesada hilmaamana waxay labadiisa gacmood horay u geysteen (oo denbiyo ah)? Hubaal waxaanu yeellay daboollo quluubtooda dushood si aanay u fahmin, iyo culeys dhegahooda, haddaad ugu yeedho hanuunkana, ma hanuunayaan weligood.

ayat.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ذُو ٱلرَّحۡمَةِۖ لَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبُواْ لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَۚ بَل لَّهُم مَّوۡعِدٞ لَّن يَجِدُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَوۡئِلٗا

en.text: And your Lord is the Forgiving, the possessor of mercy. If He were to impose blame upon them for what they earned, He would have hastened for them the punishment. Rather, for them is an appointment from which they will never find an escape.

so.text: 58. Rabbigaa (Alle) waa Denbi Dhaaf Badanaha, Naxariista Badan. Hadduu u qaban dadka waxay kasbadaan (oo denbiyo ah), wuxuu u soo dedejin lahaa cadaabka. Waxayse leeyihiin waqti go'an (Maalinta Qiyaamaha) oo aanay helayn meelay (kaga baxsadaan ama) ka magan galaan.

ayat.arabic: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰٓ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡ لَمَّا ظَلَمُواْ وَجَعَلۡنَا لِمَهۡلِكِهِم مَّوۡعِدٗا

en.text: And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time.

so.text: 59. Magaalooyinkaa (reer Caad iyo Thamuud, iwm) waan halaagnay markay dulmi (shirki iyo macaasi) faleen, waxaana u yeellay halaaggoodii waqti go’an.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَىٰهُ لَآ أَبۡرَحُ حَتَّىٰٓ أَبۡلُغَ مَجۡمَعَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ أَوۡ أَمۡضِيَ حُقُبٗا

en.text: And [mention] when Moses said to his boy [i.e., servant], "I will not cease [traveling] until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for a long period."

so.text: 60. (Xus) markuu Muuse ku yidhi adeegahiisii (Yuushac bin Nuun): Ma joogayo jeer aan gaaro halkay ku kulmaan labada badood ama aan iska socdo oo wado socodka sannado badan.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجۡمَعَ بَيۡنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ سَرَبٗا

en.text: But when they reached the junction between them, they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea, slipping away.

so.text: 61. Markayse gaadheen halkay ku kulmaan labada (badood) waxay hilmameen kalluunkoodii, oo ka dhigtay jidkiisa badda gudaheeda god oo kale.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَىٰهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا لَقَدۡ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا نَصَبٗا

en.text: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue."

so.text: 62. Markay in badan dhaafeen, wuxuu (Muuse) ku yidhi adeegihiisii: Noo keen qadadeenna; dhab ahaan waxaan kala kulannay safarkeennani daal badan.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيۡتَ إِذۡ أَوَيۡنَآ إِلَى ٱلصَّخۡرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ ٱلۡحُوتَ وَمَآ أَنسَىٰنِيهُ إِلَّا ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَنۡ أَذۡكُرَهُۥۚ وَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ عَجَبٗا

en.text: He said, "Did you see when we retired to the rock? Indeed, I forgot [there] the fish. And none made me forget it except Satan - that I should mention it. And it took its course into the sea amazingly."

so.text: 63. (Yuushac) wuxuu yidhi: Ma aragtay markaan ku nasannay buurtii dhagaxa ahayd, waxaan hilmaamay kalluunkii,  mana jiro wax I hilmaansiiyey inaan xuso aan ahayn shaydaan. Wuxuuna (kalluunka) qaaday jidkiisa xagga badda si cajab leh!

ayat.arabic: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبۡغِۚ فَٱرۡتَدَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصٗا

en.text: [Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints.

so.text: 64. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Arrinkani waa waxaanu doonaynay, markaasay dib u noqdeen iyagoo qaadaya raadadkoodii.

ayat.arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبۡدٗا مِّنۡ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمۡنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلۡمٗا

en.text: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge.

so.text: 65. Markaasay ka heleen halkaa addoon ka mid ah addoomahayga oo aan siinnay Naxariis xaggayaga ah, kaasoo aan ka barnay Xaggayaga cilmi [15].
so.footnotes: [15]. Mufasiriinta qaarkood waxay sheegeen iyagoo daliilsanaya xadiis laga soo weriyey Nabiga s.c.w. in addoonka halkan loola jeedo Al-Khadir, naxariistana loola jeedo Waxyiga iyo Nabinnimada la siiyey, cilmigana loo jeedo cilmi Ghaybka sida ku iman doonto Aayadaha xiga. Caamada qaar ayaa rumeysan inuu Khadir dhiman oo nool yahay, taasina ma aha sax, waayo waxaa soo arooray axaadiis muujinaya inuusan nooleyn. Hadduu nool yahay wuxuu u iman lahaa Nabiga s.c.w. oo rumeyn lahaa oo u gargaari laha. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu mar xadiis ku sheegay in wixii ka billowda maalintaas hadday ka soo wareegto boqol sano axadna dhulka ku nool markaa uusan noolaan doonin boqol sano kaddib. Qisadanina waxay dhex martay Al-Khadir iyo Nabi, wiilka la socday Nabi Muuse oo u adeegayeyna wuxuu ahaa Yuushac bin Nuun oo isna Nabi noqday ka mid ah anbiyadii ilmihii Israa’iil waa’ dambe kaddib Muuse c.s.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ لَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ هَلۡ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمۡتَ رُشۡدٗا

en.text: Moses said to him, "May I follow you on [the condition] that you teach me from what you have been taught of sound judgement?"

so.text: 66. Muuse wuxuu ku yidhi: Ma ku raaci karaa si aad ii barto waxa lagu baray oo cilmi ah lagu hanuuno.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرٗا

en.text: He said, "Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience.

so.text: 67. (Khadir) wuxuu yidhi: Adigu ma kareysid la jirkayga samir.

ayat.arabic: وَكَيۡفَ تَصۡبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهِۦ خُبۡرٗا

en.text: And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?"

so.text: 68. Sidee baadna ugu samir yeelan waxaadan cilmi ku koobin?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ صَابِرٗا وَلَآ أَعۡصِي لَكَ أَمۡرٗا

en.text: [Moses] said, "You will find me, if Allāh wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in [any] order."

so.text: 69. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Haddii Alle Idmo, waxaad iga heli samir, kugumana caasinayo arrinna.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنِ ٱتَّبَعۡتَنِي فَلَا تَسۡـَٔلۡنِي عَن شَيۡءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ أُحۡدِثَ لَكَ مِنۡهُ ذِكۡرٗا

en.text: He said, "Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I make to you about it mention [i.e., explanation]."

so.text: 70. (Khadir) wuxuu yidhi: Haddaad i raacdo markaa yeysan jirin wax aad wax iga wey- diiso jeer aan kaaga warramo maahee.

ayat.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِي ٱلسَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَاۖ قَالَ أَخَرَقۡتَهَا لِتُغۡرِقَ أَهۡلَهَا لَقَدۡ جِئۡتَ شَيۡـًٔا إِمۡرٗا

en.text: So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, he [i.e., al-Khiḍr] tore it open. [Moses] said, "Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing."

so.text: 71. Markaasay tageen ilaa ay koreen doonni, oo uu duleeliyey (looxii doonta); (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Ma waxaad u duleelisay inaad qarqido dadkeeda? Waxaad la timid arrin fool xun.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُلۡ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرٗا

en.text: [Al-Khiḍr] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?"

so.text: 72.Wuxuu yiri: Miyaanan kugu odhan, adigu ma kareysid la jirkayga samir?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنِي بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرۡهِقۡنِي مِنۡ أَمۡرِي عُسۡرٗا

en.text: [Moses] said, "Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not overwhelm me in my matter with difficulty."

so.text: 73. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Ha ii qabanin waxaan hilmaamo [16], hana igu kallifin wax adag aan dhibsado arrinkaygan (wax barashada) darteed.
so.footnotes: [16]. Abuu Hurayra a.k.r. waxaa laga soo weriyey inuu yidhi: Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: Alle wuu u dhaafay ummadeyda (wixii ku soo dhaca) naftooda (oo camallo xun ah) marba haddaysan ku dhaqmin ama ku dhawaaqin iyo wixii halmaan uga dhaca iyo wixii lagu qasbo.».

ayat.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَٰمٗا فَقَتَلَهُۥ قَالَ أَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا زَكِيَّةَۢ بِغَيۡرِ نَفۡسٖ لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتَ شَيۡـٔٗا نُّكۡرٗا

en.text: So they set out, until when they met a boy, he [i.e., al-Khiḍr] killed him. [Moses] said, "Have you killed a pure soul for other than [having killed] a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing."

so.text: 74. Way tageen ilaa ay la kulmeen wiil (yar), markaasuu dilay. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Ma waxaad dishay naf daahir ah oo aan naf dilin? Waxaad la timid wax xun oo aan la qaadan karin.

ayat.arabic: ۞ قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرٗا

en.text: [Al-Khiḍr] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?"

so.text: 75. (Khadir) wuxuu yidhi: Miyaanan kugu odhan:Adigu ma kareysid la jirkeyga samir?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ إِن سَأَلۡتُكَ عَن شَيۡءِۭ بَعۡدَهَا فَلَا تُصَٰحِبۡنِيۖ قَدۡ بَلَغۡتَ مِن لَّدُنِّي عُذۡرٗا

en.text: [Moses] said, "If I should ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion. You have obtained from me an excuse."

so.text: 76. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Haddaan ku weydiiyo wax ka dambeeya tani, haba yee- lin inaan kula socdo, waxaad dhab ahaan heshay cudur daar xagga arrinkeyga.

ayat.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَيَآ أَهۡلَ قَرۡيَةٍ ٱسۡتَطۡعَمَآ أَهۡلَهَا فَأَبَوۡاْ أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارٗا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُۥۖ قَالَ لَوۡ شِئۡتَ لَتَّخَذۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ أَجۡرٗا

en.text: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so he [i.e., al-Khiḍr] restored it. [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment."

so.text: 77. Way tageen jeer markay ku yimaadeen dad magaalo deggan, waxay weydiisteen cunno dadkeeda, wayse diideen inay marti sooraan [17]; markaasay waxay heleen gudaheeda gidaar dumi raba, markaasuu (Khadir) toosiyey. (Muuse) Wuxuu yidhi: Haddaad doonto, waxaad ku qaadan lahayd ujro.
so.footnotes: [17]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Qofkii rumeysan Alle iyo Maalinta Aakhiro waa inuu wanaajiyo martidiisa, oo qofkii rumeysan Alle iyo Maalinta Aakhiro waa inuu ka ilaaliyo dhib oo dhan jaarkiis, oo qofkii rumeysan Alle iyo Maalinta Aakhiro waa inuu ku hadlo hadal wanaagsan oo khayr ah ama iska aamuso. (W.w. Abuu Daawuud)

ayat.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنِكَۚ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأۡوِيلِ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡتَطِع عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرًا

en.text: [Al-Khiḍr] said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.

so.text: 78. (Khadir) wuxuu yidhi: Kan waa kala tagga dhexdeenna aniga iyo adiga, ee waxaan kuu sheegi fasiraadda waxaad u samir yeelan kari weyday.

ayat.arabic: أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتۡ لِمَسَٰكِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنۡ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٞ يَأۡخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصۡبٗا

en.text: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.

so.text: 79. Ma doonnida, waxaa lahaa dad masaa- kiin ah oo badda ka xoogsada. Waxaana doonay inaan ceeb u yeelo, waayo waxaa hortooda ahaa boqor ku qaata doonni walba (oo hagaagsan) qasab.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡغُلَٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤۡمِنَيۡنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرۡهِقَهُمَا طُغۡيَٰنٗا وَكُفۡرٗا

en.text: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.

so.text: 80. Wiilkana, waxay labadiisii waalid ahaayeen mu’ miniin, waxaana ka baqnay inuu ku dhibo xadgudub iyo abaal dhac.

ayat.arabic: فَأَرَدۡنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُ زَكَوٰةٗ وَأَقۡرَبَ رُحۡمٗا

en.text: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.

so.text: 81. Waxaana doonnay inuu ugu beddelo Rabbigood mid ka khayr roon daahirinimo oo naxariisasho dhow.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَٰمَيۡنِ يَتِيمَيۡنِ فِي ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحۡتَهُۥ كَنزٞ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَٰلِحٗا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبۡلُغَآ أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسۡتَخۡرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ وَمَا فَعَلۡتُهُۥ عَنۡ أَمۡرِيۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَأۡوِيلُ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡطِع عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرٗا

en.text: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."

so.text: 82. Gidaarkana, waxaa lahaa labo wiil oo agoomo ah oo magaalada jooga; waxaana hoostiisa yaalay khaznad maal ah ay iyagu leeyihiin; wuxuuna ahaa aabbahood qof wanaagsan, marka Wuxuu Rabbigaa doonay inay qaan gaaraan oo la soo baxaan khasnaddooda, naxariis ka ahaatay xagga Rabbigaa; kumana aan samayn waxaan falay amarkayga. Waana kaas tafsiirka (arrimihii) aad u samir yeelan kari weyday.

ayat.arabic: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِي ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِۖ قُلۡ سَأَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنۡهُ ذِكۡرًا

en.text: And they ask you, [O Muḥammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report."

so.text: 83. Waxay wax kaa weydiin Dul Qarnayn. Dheh: Waxaan idiin akhrin war ku saabsan isaga.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ سَبَبٗا

en.text: Indeed, We established him upon the earth, and We gave him from everything a way [i.e., means].

so.text:
84. Waxaan ku awood siinnay dhulka, waxaana u siinnay wax walba sabab 
 (cilmi).

ayat.arabic: فَأَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا

en.text: So he followed a way

so.text: 85. Wuxuu raacay waddo.

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغۡرِبَ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغۡرُبُ فِي عَيۡنٍ حَمِئَةٖ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوۡمٗاۖ قُلۡنَا يَٰذَا ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ إِمَّآ أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّآ أَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمۡ حُسۡنٗا

en.text: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun [i.e., the west], he found it [as if] setting in a body of dark water,[795] and he found near it a people. We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness."
en.footnotes: [795] Another meaning is "a body of hot water."

so.text: 86. Ilaa, markuu gaaray meeshay u dhacdo qorraxdu, wuxuu helay iyadoo ku dhaceysa il dhoobo madow ah [18], oo ka helay agteeda qolo. Waxaanu nidhi: Dul Qarnaynow! Ama waa inaad cadaabto (hadday diidaan inay Xaqa rumeeyaan) ama u axsaan fasho (oo barto Islaamka).
so.footnotes: [18]. Macno kale waa il biyo kulul.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوۡفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابٗا نُّكۡرٗا

en.text: He said, "As for one who wrongs,[796] we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment [i.e., Hellfire].
en.footnotes: [796] Persists in disbelief and rebellion.

so.text: 87. Wuxuu yidhi: Qofkii dulmi fala 'oo fallaagooba' [19], waa aanu cadaabi (dili), haddana waxaa loo celin xagga Rabbigiis; wuxuuna ku cadaabi cadaab daran.
so.footnotes: [19]. Ku adkeysta shirki, gaalnimo, denbi, iwm oo aan dooneyn inuu hanuuno oo qaato Islaamka.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلَهُۥ جَزَآءً ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۖ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِنَا يُسۡرٗا

en.text: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of the best [i.e., Paradise], and we [i.e., Dhul-Qarnayn] will speak to him from our command with ease."

so.text: 88. Qofkii se (Xaqa) rumeeya oo sama fala, wuxuu leeyahay abaal gud wanaagsan (Janno). Waxaana kula hadli ereyo nugul oo amarkayaga ah.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا

en.text: Then he followed a way

so.text: 89. Markaasuu raacay waddo (kale),

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطۡلِعَ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطۡلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ لَّمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتۡرٗا

en.text: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun [i.e., the east], he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield.

so.text: 90. Ilaa markuu gaaray meeshay ka soo baxdo qorraxda wuxuu helay iyadoo ay u soo baxaysa qolo aynu siin wax ay isaga asturaan [20].
so.footnotes: [20]. Dad masaakiin ah aan waxba heysan.

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَقَدۡ أَحَطۡنَا بِمَا لَدَيۡهِ خُبۡرٗا

en.text: Thus.[797] And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.
en.footnotes: [797] Such was the affair of Dhul-Qarnayn.

so.text: 91. Sidaas weeyee! Waxaana ku koobnay ogaansho waxa uu heystay.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا

en.text: Then he followed a way

so.text: 92. Markaasuu raacay waddo (kale),

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيۡنَ ٱلسَّدَّيۡنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوۡمٗا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفۡقَهُونَ قَوۡلٗا

en.text: Until, when he reached [a pass] between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand [his] speech.

so.text: 93. Ilaa markuu gaaray (meel) labo buurood dhexdooda ah; wuxuu sokodooda ka helay qolo dhib ku fahma hadalba [21].
so.footnotes: [21]. Waxay ahaayeen dad aan garaneyn af aan ahayn afkooda, waayo afkooda wuu ka duwanaa afafka qeyrkood, mana caddeyn karin muraadkooda aqoon yari darteed.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰذَا ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ إِنَّ يَأۡجُوجَ وَمَأۡجُوجَ مُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَهَلۡ نَجۡعَلُ لَكَ خَرۡجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجۡعَلَ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ سَدّٗا

en.text: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog[798] are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"
en.footnotes: [798] Savage tribes who had ravaged large parts of central Asia, committing every kind of atrocity.

so.text: 94. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Dul Qarnaynow! Waxay Yuug iyo yamaayuug [22] ku falaan fasahaad arlada. Ee ma kuu yeellaa kharash waxaase shardi ah inaad yeesho dhexdeenna innaga iyo iyaga xidh gidaar ah?
so.footnotes: [22]. Ya’juuj iyo Ma’juuj waa labo qolo oo waxshi ah oo deggan qaybo ballaaran oo ka mid ah Aasiyada dhexe, kuwaasoo fala nooc kasta oo fasahaad ah.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّي فِيهِ رَبِّي خَيۡرٞ فَأَعِينُونِي بِقُوَّةٍ أَجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ رَدۡمًا

en.text: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam.

so.text: 95. Wuxuu yidhi: Wuxuu awood I siiyey Rabbigay baa igu filan oo khayr roon, ee igu caawiya xoog (shaqaale) waxaan yeeli moos xir weyn dhexdiinna idinka iyo iyaga.

ayat.arabic: ءَاتُونِي زُبَرَ ٱلۡحَدِيدِۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيۡنَ ٱلصَّدَفَيۡنِ قَالَ ٱنفُخُواْۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَعَلَهُۥ نَارٗا قَالَ ءَاتُونِيٓ أُفۡرِغۡ عَلَيۡهِ قِطۡرٗا

en.text: Bring me bars of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."

so.text: 96. Ii keena goosimo bir ah; jeer markuu simay dhinacyada labada buurood dhexdooda, wuxuu yidhi: Buufiya, ilaa markuu ka yeelay (sida) dab, wuxuu yidhi: Ii keena maar la dhalaaliyey aan ku shubee.

ayat.arabic: فَمَا ٱسۡطَٰعُوٓاْ أَن يَظۡهَرُوهُ وَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ لَهُۥ نَقۡبٗا

en.text: So they [i.e., Gog and Magog] were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.

so.text: 97. Ma ay karin (Ya'juuj iyo Ma'juuj) inay ka soo kor baxaan mana karin inay duleeliyaan.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحۡمَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّيۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّي جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّآءَۖ وَكَانَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّي حَقّٗا

en.text: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord[799] comes [i.e., approaches], He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."
en.footnotes: [799] i.e., the Hour of Resurrection.

so.text: 98. (Dul Qarnayn) wuxuu yidhi: Waxakani waa Naxariis xagga Rabbigay ah, markase uu Yabooha Rabbigay yimaado, wuxuu la simi dhulka, Yabooha Rabbigay xaq weeye.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَتَرَكۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَمُوجُ فِي بَعۡضٖۖ وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَجَمَعۡنَٰهُمۡ جَمۡعٗا

en.text: And We will leave them that day[800] surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.
en.footnotes: [800] The day the dam is destroyed.

so.text: 99.Waxaan u dayn qaarkood Maalintaa inay is buurtaan oo is dhex yaacaan (hirar oo kale) qaar kale. Waxaa la afuufi Buunka, oo soo kulmin iyagoo dhan [23].
so.footnotes: [23]. Maalinta dhismahaa weyn ee lagu xiray Ya’juuj iyo Ma’juuj la burburiyo.

ayat.arabic: وَعَرَضۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَرۡضًا

en.text: And We will present Hell that Day to the disbelievers, on display -

so.text: 100. Waxaan u bandhigeynaa Jahannama maalintaa gaalada bandhig.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَانَتۡ أَعۡيُنُهُمۡ فِي غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكۡرِي وَكَانُواْ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ سَمۡعًا

en.text: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance,[801] and they were not able to hear.[802]
en.footnotes:
[801] i.e., Allāh's signs or the Qur’ān.
[802] They refused to listen to the Qur’ān or to understand it.

so.text: 101. Kuwa ay indhahoodu ka daboollaayeen Waanadayada [24], ee aan kari jirin inay maqlaan.
so.footnotes: [24]. Waa Calaamooyinka Alle, ama Qur’aanka.

ayat.arabic: أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَن يَتَّخِذُواْ عِبَادِي مِن دُونِيٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَۚ إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ نُزُلٗا

en.text: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.

so.text: 102. Ma waxay kuwa gaalooba moodaan inay (anfaceyso) inay ka yeeshaan addoomahayga gargaarayaal Aniga sokaday? Waxaan u diyaarinnay Jahannama degaan ahaan gaalada.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ هَلۡ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلۡأَخۡسَرِينَ أَعۡمَٰلًا

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?

so.text: 103. Dheh: Ma idiin sheegaa kuwa ugu khasaaraha badan camallo ahaan?

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعۡيُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَهُمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمۡ يُحۡسِنُونَ صُنۡعًا

en.text: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."

so.text: 104. Waa kuwaa camalkooda noloshan adduunka yahay khasaaro aan wax qiimo ah laheyn iyagoo mooda inay sama falaan?

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتۡ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَزۡنٗا

en.text: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any weight [i.e., importance].

so.text: 105. Kuwaasu waa kuwa ku gaalooba Aayadaha Rabbigood iyo la kulankiisa [25]. Marka camalladooda waa buraan. Sidaas awgeed uma yeelno wax miisaan iyo qiimo ah Maalinta Qiyaamaha.
so.footnotes: [25]. Waxay diidaan inay dhageystaan Qur’aanka ama fahmaan oo waxay beeniyaan Maalinta Dambe ‘Aakhirada’.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُواْ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِي وَرُسُلِي هُزُوًا

en.text: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.

so.text: 106. Sidaas waa in abaalkoodu yahay Jahannama; gaalnimadooda darteed, waxayna ka yeesheen Aayadahayga iyo Rusushayda jeesjees.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلۡفِرۡدَوۡسِ نُزُلًا

en.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise[803] as a lodging,
en.footnotes: [803] i.e., the highest part of Paradise, al-Firdaus.

so.text: 107. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey ee samaha fala waxay leeyihiin beeraha Al-Firdaws [26] degitaan (marti qaad) ahaan.
so.footnotes: [26]. Al-Firdaws waa halka ugu sarreysa uguna fiican Jannada.

ayat.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبۡغُونَ عَنۡهَا حِوَلٗا

en.text: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.

so.text: 108. Iyagoo ku dhex waaraya weligood mana doonaan inay xaggeeda ka wareegaan (guuraan).

ayat.arabic: قُل لَّوۡ كَانَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ مِدَادٗا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّي لَنَفِدَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ قَبۡلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّي وَلَوۡ جِئۡنَا بِمِثۡلِهِۦ مَدَدٗا

en.text: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words[804] of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it in [continual] supplement."
en.footnotes: [804] The words of Allāh's unlimited knowledge or words describing His attributes and His grandeur or praise of Him (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).

so.text: 109. Dheh: Hadday baddu ahaan laheyd khad loogu tala galay (qoridda) Kelmedaha Rabbigay [27], baddu waa dhammaan lahayd inta aysan dhammaan Kelmedaha Rabbigay, xataa haddaan keenno (bad kale) oo la mid ah oo taakulo u ahaato.
so.footnotes: [27]. Kelmedahaa waa amarrada Alle ee aan la soo koobi karin ama Kelmedaha sheegaya Tilmaamahiisa ama Ammaanahiisa.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلۡيَعۡمَلۡ عَمَلٗا صَٰلِحٗا وَلَا يُشۡرِكۡ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدَۢا

en.text: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."

so.text: 110. (Nabi Muxammadow) dheh: Waxaan anigu uun ahay qof idinkoo kale ah, waxaa la ii waxyooday inuu ilaahiinnu yahay Ilaah Mid Keliya ah (Allaah), ee kii rajo ka qaba la Kulanka Rabbigii, ha fasho camallo san oo yuusan la wadaajin cidna cibaadada Rabbigi.

ayat.arabic: يسٓ

en.text: Yā, Seen.[1260]
en.footnotes: [1260] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Yaasiin [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2: Aayadda 1

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ

en.text: By the wise[1261] Qur’ān,
en.footnotes: [1261] See footnote to 10:1.

so.text: 2. Waxaan ku dhaartay Qur’aanka, Xikmadda Badan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,

so.text: 3. Hubaal adigu (Muxammadow) waxaad ka mid tahay (Rususha Alle) soo diray.

ayat.arabic: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

en.text: On a straight path.

so.text: 4. Waxaad ku sugan tahay Jid Toosan.

ayat.arabic: تَنزِيلَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

en.text: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

so.text: 5. (Qur’aankani waa) Waxyi ka soo degay (xagga Alle) Adkaadaha, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمٗا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ

en.text: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.

so.text: 6. Inaad u digto qolo aan aabbayaashood loo digin, ee iyagu ah kuwo dhoohan.

ayat.arabic: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.

so.text: 7. Waxaa dhab ahaan ku rumoobay badankood Qowlka (Cadaabka), marka ma ay rumeeyaan (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ أَغۡلَٰلٗا فَهِيَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَذۡقَانِ فَهُم مُّقۡمَحُونَ

en.text: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.

so.text: 8. (Waa sida) inaan yeelnay mareegyo bir ah luqumahooda oo gaadha ilaa gararkooda, sidaa awgeed madaxyadooda  kor u taagan yihiin [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Marka way ka xidhan yihiin khayr oo dhan, Xaqana ma arkaan.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ سَدّٗا وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدّٗا فَأَغۡشَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.

so.text: 9. Waxaan yeellay hortooda xidh, gadaashoodana xidh kale, waana arag daboolnay marka ma arkaan (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

so.text: 10. Waa isugu mid haddaad u digto ama aad u digin, (marna) ma rumeeyaan (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةٖ وَأَجۡرٖ كَرِيمٍ

en.text: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.

so.text: 11.Waxaad uun u digi (oo ay anfaci digadu) kan raaca Qur’aanka oo ka baqa Raxmaan- ka sir (iyo saaqba). Ee ugu bishaaree denbi dhaaf iyo abaalgud sharaf leh (Janno).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُواْ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمۡۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ فِيٓ إِمَامٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.

so.text: 12. Xaqiiq waa Annaga kuwa nooleyn meytida, oo qora waxay hormarsadaan iyo raadadkoodaba (waxay gadaal uga soo tagaan khayr ama shar). Wax walba waxaynu ku koobnay [3] (oo qornay) Kitaab cad (Looxa Maxfuudka).
so.footnotes: [3]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Qofka markuu dhinto wuu go’aa camalkiisu seddex mooyee: Cilmi lagu intifaaco, ilmo wanaagsan oo u soo duceeya iyo sadaqo u socota (waqaf)”.

ayat.arabic: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ إِذۡ جَآءَهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

en.text: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -

so.text: 13. Waxaad ugu soo qaadataa tusaale; (qisada) dadkii magaalada (Antaakiya), markay u yimaadeen Rusushii (loo soo diray).

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٖ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُم مُّرۡسَلُونَ

en.text: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."

so.text: 14. Markaan u dirnay Xaggooda labo (xertii Ciise ah), markaasay labadiiba beeniyeen, markaasaan ku xoojinnay mid seddexaad, waxayna yidhaahdeen: Waxaanu nahay Rusul xaggiinna loo soo diray.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ مَآ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا تَكۡذِبُونَ

en.text: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."

so.text: 15.Waxay 'dadkii magaalada' yidhaahdeen: Ma ahidin waxaan ahayn dad nala mid ah, mana soo dejin Raxmaanku waxba, ee been uun baad sheegeysaan.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُونَ

en.text: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,

so.text: 16. Waxay (Rusushii) yidhaahdeen: Rabbigayo waa Og yahay inaan nahay Rusul xaggiinna loo soo diray.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."

so.text: 17. Nama saarna waxaan ahayn gaarsiin cad (ee Diinta Alle - Islaamka).

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهُواْ لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

en.text: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

so.text: 18. Waxay 'dadkii magaalada' yidhaahdeen: Waan idin shareysannay, haddaydaan joojin (waxaad waddaan), waan idin dhagaxyeyn waxaana idinka taaban xaggayaga cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمۡ أَئِن ذُكِّرۡتُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٞ مُّسۡرِفُونَ

en.text: They said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with yourselves. Is it[1262] because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
en.footnotes: [1262] Your threat against us.

so.text: 19. Waxay (Rusushii) yidhaahdeen: Shareysigiinnu waa la jirkiin (waana sababta shirkigiinna iyo xume falkiinna),  ma in la idin waaniyey darteed [4]? Mayee, waxaad tihiin qolo xadgudub badan.
so.footnotes: [4]. Gooddinta aad noo gooddineysaan ma waxaa u sabab ah inaan wax xaq ah idiin sheegno oo idinku waaninno.

ayat.arabic: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ أَقۡصَا ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٞ يَسۡعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُواْ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.

so.text: 20. Waxaa ka yimid magaalada dhan- keeda shishe nin rooraya, wuxuu yidhi: tolkayow! Raaca Rususha;

ayat.arabic: ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَن لَّا يَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ أَجۡرٗا وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.

so.text: 21. Raaca kuwo aan idin weydiisan wax abaal gud ah, oo hanuunsan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَالِيَ لَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?

so.text: 22. Maxaan u caabudeynin (Alle Keliya) ee ah kan i abuuray? Xaggiisaana la idin soo celin.

ayat.arabic: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدۡنِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ بِضُرّٖ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ

en.text: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?

so.text: 23. Ma waxaan yeeshaa (Alle) sokadi ilaahyo (kale), hadduu Raxmaanku (Alle) ila doono dhibaato, ayan i tareyn  garab siintoodu waxba, oo aan awoodinba  inay i badbaadiyaan?

ayat.arabic: إِنِّيٓ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ

en.text: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

so.text: 24. Markaa xaqiiq waxaan ku suganahay habow cad.

ayat.arabic: إِنِّيٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَٱسۡمَعُونِ

en.text: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."

so.text: 25. Hubaal anigu waxaan rumeeyey Rabbigiin, ee i maqla.

ayat.arabic: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلِ ٱلۡجَنَّةَۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِي يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: It was said, "Enter Paradise."[1263] He said, "I wish my people could know
en.footnotes: [1263] An abrupt transfer to the Hereafter conveys the meaning that the man met a violent death at the hands of the disbelievers and so was martyred for the cause of Allāh.

so.text: 26. Waxaa la yidhi: Gal jannada. Wuxuu yidhi: Alla dadkaygu may ogaadaan [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Ninkaa waxaa la odhan jirey Xabiib oo ahaa geed qore, sidaas darteed baa waxaa loo yiqiin Xabiib Al-Najjaar. Inta aysan nafta ka bixin waxaa soo degay malaa’ig ugu bishaaraysay in loo dhaafay dhammaan dunuubtiisa oo uu geli doono Jannada. Magaaladaas waxay ahayd Antaakiya.

ayat.arabic: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ

en.text: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."

so.text: 27. Sida Rabbigay iigu denbi dhaafay, oo uu iiga mid yeelay kuwa la sharfay!

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ مِن جُندٖ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ

en.text: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.

so.text: 28. Kuma aanu soo dejin qolodiisii  gadaashi wax ciidan ah aan kaga keennay samada, mana aanu falno sidaas.

ayat.arabic: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَإِذَا هُمۡ خَٰمِدُونَ

en.text: It was not but one shout,[1264] and immediately they were extinguished.
en.footnotes: [1264] From Gabriel or a blast from the sky.

so.text: 29. Waxay ahayd dhawaaq qaylo keliya ah, markaasay wada baseen.

ayat.arabic: يَٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى ٱلۡعِبَادِۚ مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

en.text: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.

so.text: 30. Maxay qoomamo u ahaatay addoomaha! Ma jiro Rasuul u yimaada aanay ku jeesjeesin.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ

en.text: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them[1265] will not return?
en.footnotes: [1265] i.e., to those living presently in the world.

so.text: 31. Miyeyna ogaan intee baan facyo halaagnay hortood, aan xaggooda u soo noqonayn?

ayat.arabic: وَإِن كُلّٞ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٞ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ

en.text: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

so.text: 32. Kulligoodna iyagoo dhan Hortayadaa la keeni.

ayat.arabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةُ أَحۡيَيۡنَٰهَا وَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبّٗا فَمِنۡهُ يَأۡكُلُونَ

en.text: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.

so.text: 33. Waxaa Calaamo u ah arlada meydka ah aanu nooleyno, kana soo saarno hadhuudh ay wax ka cunaan.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٖ مِّن نَّخِيلٖ وَأَعۡنَٰبٖ وَفَجَّرۡنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡعُيُونِ

en.text: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -

so.text: 34. Waxaana yeellay dhexdeeda beero timir ah iyo canabyo, oo ka burqinnay dhexdeeda ilo (biyo ah).

ayat.arabic: لِيَأۡكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: That they may eat of His fruit.[1266] And their hands have not produced it,[1267] so will they not be grateful?
en.footnotes:
[1266] i.e., that which Allāh has produced for them.
[1267] An alternative meaning is "And [eat from] what their hands have produced [i.e., planted and harvested]." Both are grammatically correct.

so.text: 35. Si ay wax uga cunaan midhahiisa, mana ayan sameyn gacmahoodu [6]. Ee Ma waysan (Alle u) mahad naqeyn?
so.footnotes: [6]. Macno kale: Waa inay wax ka cunaan waxa ay gacmahoodu faleen (beereen oo soo goosteen). Labada macnoba waa sax.

ayat.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Exalted is He who created all pairs[1268] - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
en.footnotes: [1268] Or "all species."

so.text: 36. Waxaa xurmo oo dhan iska leh oo ka hufan  (xumaan, Alle ee) abuuray noocyada dhammaan wuxuu dhulka soo saaro, iyo nafahooda iyo waxa aysan ogayn.

ayat.arabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيۡلُ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظۡلِمُونَ

en.text: And a sign for them is the night. We remove[1269] from it the [light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
en.footnotes: [1269] Literally, "strip" or "peel." Sunlight projected onto the earth is removed from it as the earth turns and night approaches.

so.text: 37. waxaa Calaamo ugu sugan habeenka, aan ka soo saarno maalinta, oo markaas ay mugdi galaan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرّٖ لَّهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ

en.text: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

so.text: 38. Qorraxdu waxay ku oroddaa rugo ay leedahay. (Arrin)kaasi waa Qaddarka (Alle) Adkaadaha Sare, wax kasta Ogsoonaha ah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلۡعُرۡجُونِ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ

en.text: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.

so.text: 39. Dayaxa waxaanu u qaddarnay heerar uu maro ilaa uu soo noqdo mar kale sida laan timireed qallalan oo gabowday.

ayat.arabic: لَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ يَنۢبَغِي لَهَآ أَن تُدۡرِكَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَكُلّٞ فِي فَلَكٖ يَسۡبَحُونَ

en.text: It is not allowable [i.e., possible] for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.

so.text: 40. Looma oggola qorraxda inay haleesho dayaxa, habeenkuna ma ka hor maro maalinta. Dhammaan waxay ku dabaashaan mareeg (garangar) dhexdi.

ayat.arabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمۡ أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ

en.text: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers[1270] in a laden ship.
en.footnotes: [1270] Usually meaning "descendants" or "offspring," the word "dhurriyyah" is used here to denote forefathers (their being the offspring of Noah), who were saved from the flood.

so.text: 41. Waxaa Calaamo ugu filan inaan ku qaadnay ubadkoodii [7] Doonidii buuxday.
so.footnotes: [7]. Weedha durriyad halkan waxaa loola jeedaa fir (waa inay yihiin firkii Nuux) ee laga badbaadshay daadkii weynaa ee lagu halaagay qoonkii Nuux.

ayat.arabic: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ مَا يَرۡكَبُونَ

en.text: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.

so.text: 42. Waxaana uga abuurnay wax caynkeed ah waxay fuulaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن نَّشَأۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنقَذُونَ

en.text: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

so.text: 43. Haddaan doonnona waanu harqin, markaa ma helaan wax u soo gurmada, lamana badbaadiyo.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٖ

en.text: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

so.text: 44. Naxariis Xaggayaga ah mooyee iyo raaxo ilaa muddo ah.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُواْ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ

en.text: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you;[1271] perhaps you will receive mercy..."[1272]
en.footnotes:
[1271] Of sins or of life in this world and the Hereafter.
[1272] The conclusion of this sentence is understood to be "...they ignored the warning."

so.text: 45. Marka (gaalada) lagu yidhaahdo: Iska jira waxa ah hortiinna iyo waxa ah gadaashiinna [8] si la idiinkugu naxariisto 'ma maqlaan' [9].
so.footnotes:
[8]. Waxaa loola jeedaa Aakhirada iyo cadaabkeeda iyo adduunka iyo xaaladahiisa kala duwan. 
[9]. Macnaha way iska dhego tiraan waanooyinka oo dan u geli waayaan digniinaha.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٖ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ

en.text: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

so.text: 46. Uma timaaddo calaamad ka mid ah calaamooyinka Rabbigood, wayse ka sii jeesadaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنُطۡعِمُ مَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطۡعَمَهُۥٓ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allāh has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allāh had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."

so.text: 47. Marka lagu yidhaahdo: Wax ka bixiya waxa uu Alle idinku irsaaqay, kuwa gaalooba waxay ku yidhaahdaan kuwa (xaqa) rumeeyey: Ma waxaan quudinnaa`mid hadduu doono Alle uu quudin lahaa? Idinku kuma sugnidin waxaan ahayn habow cad.

ayat.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

so.text: 48.Waxay (gaaladu) odhan: Goormay gooddintani fuli, haddaad run sheegaysaan?

ayat.arabic: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ تَأۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُونَ

en.text: They do not await except one blast[1273] which will seize them while they are disputing.
en.footnotes: [1273] Literally, "cry" or "shriek," meaning the first blast of the Horn which will strike dead every living thing on the earth without warning.

so.text: 49. Ma sugayaan (gaaladu) wax kale aan aheyn hal Qaylo [10], qabaneysa iyagoo murmi.
so.footnotes: [10]. Erey ahaan macnaha waa dhawaaq ama qeylo daran, waxaana loola jeedaa afuufka koowaad ee Buunka uu dhiman noole kasta oo dhulka jooga digniin hore la’aan.

ayat.arabic: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ تَوۡصِيَةٗ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ

en.text: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.

so.text: 50. Markaas ma karaan dardaaran, ehelkoodiina uma soo noqdaan.

ayat.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَنسِلُونَ

en.text: And the Horn will be blown;[1274] and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
en.footnotes: [1274] For the second time, signaling the Resurrection.

so.text: 51. Buunkaa la aafuufi [11], mise kolkaa bay qubuurahooda ka soo yaaci iygoo u degdegaya xagga Rabbigood.
so.footnotes: [11]. Waxaa loola jeedaa afuufka labaad ee Buunka, markaasoo ay ka soo bixi doonaan qubuuraha iyagoo la soo nooleeyey.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرۡقَدِنَاۜۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

en.text: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

so.text: 52. Waxay odhan: Hoognaye! Yaa naga soo kiciyey meeshayadii aan hurudnay? (Waxaa lagu odhan): Kanu waa wuxuu Raxmaan- ku ballan qaaday, Rusushuna run bay sheegeen.

ayat.arabic: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَإِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيعٞ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ

en.text: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.

so.text:
53. Ma ahaaneyso wax kale aan aheyn hal Qaylo keliya, Mise kolkaa! Waxay dham-     
 maan ahaan kuwo Hortayada la keeno.

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.

so.text: 54. Marka Maanta (Qiyaamada) lagama dulmiyo nafna waxba, la idinkana abaal marin maayo waxaad camal fasheen mooyee.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي شُغُلٖ فَٰكِهُونَ

en.text: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -

so.text: 55. Hubaal ehlu-jannuhu, waxay maalintaas ku sugnaan shuqul (la raaxeysi xaasaskooda) iyagoo faraxsan.

ayat.arabic: هُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُمۡ فِي ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ

en.text: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

so.text: 56. Iyaga iyo xaasaskoodu waxay ku sugnaan hoosas harac ah, iyagoo ku dangiigsanaan sariiro sare.

ayat.arabic: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ

en.text: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

so.text: 57. Waxay ku lahaan midho gudaheeda waxayna lahaan waxay doonaanba.

ayat.arabic: سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡلٗا مِّن رَّبّٖ رَّحِيمٖ

en.text: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

so.text: 58. Salaam (Nabad ahaada): waa qowl uga imaan Rabbi, Naxariis Badan (Allaah Kor ahaaye).

ayat.arabic: وَٱمۡتَٰزُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ

en.text: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.[1275]
en.footnotes: [1275] i.e., remove yourself from the ranks of the believers to be distinguished from them.
